mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalAssessments, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL IN ('B', 'C') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS highRiskCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL IN ('BBB', 'BB') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mediumRiskCount, SUM(CASE WHEN RISK_LEVEL IN ('AAA', 'AA', 'A') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lowRiskCount FROM TC_PARTNER_RISK_ASSESSMENT WHERE IS_ENABLED = 1
